item.text: The current code proxies only inside `display`, and it rebuilds the call with every default keyword. That loses the original `warning`/`deprecated` method context and makes exact argument forwarding impossible. I’m moving the fork check into a decorator on all three public methods, then carrying the method name through `DisplaySend` for dispatch in the result thread.
